verification_note: Delhi is a fully segregated code path. Notably, its instrument set is not a subset of any other state's — the absence of an instrument here is itself a state-level fact that must be verified, not inferred.

instruments.title: Delhi Shops and Establishments Act, 1954
instruments.authority: Labour Department, Government of NCT of Delhi

obligations.summary: Establishments in the NCT register with the Delhi labour department under its own rules.
Hours, closing days and leave follow Delhi rules.
Welfare fund contribution is payable to the Delhi board on its own cycle.

state_level_absences.assertion: Delhi has historically not levied a professional tax of the kind imposed by Telangana, Andhra Pradesh, Maharashtra and Karnataka.
state_level_absences.instruction: Do not present this absence as settled to a user until a reviewer has confirmed it against the Delhi finance department's current position. An absence is a claim like any other.

state_escalation_triggers: Cross-NCR operations: a workplace in Noida (Uttar Pradesh) or Gurugram (Haryana) is a different state path even when staff sit in the same metro area.
